# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pārājika 5 (Bi-Vb Pj5)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pj5
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pārājika 5
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul4.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The rule stipulates that a lustful nun who consents to a lustful man touching her anywhere between the collarbones and the knees is expelled from the Saṅgha. The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
